page_title: EVE 1-1 BHA | Everton v Brighton 04/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+1' James Tarkowski (Everton) attempts to beat Bart Verbruggen with a header from the resulting corner kick. He sends his effort towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a nice save. The score remains the same.
90+1' Everton have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Ashley Young and he is replaced by Nathan Patterson (Everton).
90' The referee signals a substitution. Beto (Everton) is brought on as a substitute for Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Igor (Brighton) replaces Simon Adingra.
88' The ball is out of play. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner.
84' 1 - 1 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Ashley Young (Everton), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the roof of his own net.
81' What was James Tarkowski (Everton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
81' Joel Veltman (Brighton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tim Robinson no option but to blow his whistle.
79' Here comes a substitution. Facundo Buonanotte (Brighton) is brought on as a substitute for James Milner.
77' Yellow card. Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
75' Dwight McNeil (Everton) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
74' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
73' Joao Pedro (Brighton) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Joao Pedro (Brighton) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
70' Everton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to make a change. Mahmoud Dahoud (Brighton) replaces Billy Gilmour.
68' Substitution. Ansu Fati (Brighton) in, Evan Ferguson out.
68' Close! Pascal Gross (Brighton) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar.
64' James Garner (Everton) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
64' Joel Veltman (Brighton) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
62' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and signals a foul after James Milner (Brighton) brought his opponent down.
61' The Brighton players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
59' Joao Pedro (Brighton) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

55' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the top right corner but is denied by Jordan Pickford, who pulls off a glorious save!
54' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
53' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.
51' Lewis Dunk (Brighton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
48' Pascal Gross (Brighton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
48' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Billy Gilmour (Brighton) is thwarted and cleared to safety. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Roberto De Zerbi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Adam Lallana. He is replaced by Joao Pedro (Brighton).
46' Referee Tim Robinson blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
43' Dwight McNeil (Everton) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
42' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
41' Simon Adingra (Brighton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
40' James Tarkowski (Everton) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
39' Tim Robinson blows the whistle, Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is penalised for a foul.
38' Shots on target – 3:1.
34' The ball is cleared after Jack Harrison (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
32' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
32' Pascal Gross (Brighton) tries to find Kaoru Mitoma with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
31' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the right post.
30' Simon Adingra (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) dribbles into the box, but Jordan Pickford is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
25' James Garner (Everton) lines up the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but he produces a poor shot that goes high over the bar. The ball could have snow on it when it returns!
23' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lewis Dunk (Brighton) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
21' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
20' Billy Gilmour (Brighton) goes into the referee's book for dissent.
20' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
20' Simon Adingra (Brighton) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
17' The goal by Brighton won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
16' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Brighton players aren’t happy.

14' Sensational! Lewis Dunk (Brighton) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the underside of the crossbar and into the net. The assist goes to Pascal Gross and the score changes to 1:1.
14' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
14' The percentage of ball possession is – 10:90.
10' Simon Adingra (Brighton) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.
7' 1 - 0 Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) gets to the ball after a big mistake by the defending player and scores with a precise shot into the left side of the goal.
6' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.

5' Unbelievable! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) wastes a huge scoring opportunity! He finds himself unmarked right in front of goal and fires in a first-time shot. Bart Verbruggen pulls off one of the best saves of his career and stops the effort from hitting the net.
4' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
3' Brighton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brighton will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
